name: What is the difference between a bathroom renovation and a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a bathroom renovation and a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom renovation focuses on aesthetic and surface upgrades like replacing a vanity, painting, and swapping tile, while a remodel involves structural or spatial alterations such as moving walls, expanding a shower footprint, or reconfiguring plumbing rough-ins. Surface renovations typically take less time and involve fewer trades. In contrast, altering the footprint requires coordinated plumbing, electrical rough-ins, custom framing, and drywall work. HH Remodeling handles both scopes, providing direct finish carpentry and tile installation while coordinating required mechanical sub-trades.
acceptedAnswer.description: A renovation updates existing surfaces and fixtures, while a remodel changes the layout, moves plumbing lines, or alters the physical room footprint.
